raw.query: WITH hf AS (SELECT gpu, image_px, n_images, mean_ms AS hf_mean_ms FROM provenance.collector_fn WHERE engine = 'measured_5x50'), aic AS (SELECT gpu, image_px, n_images, aic_ms FROM provenance.collector_fn WHERE engine = 'aic_postinfill'), pairs AS (SELECT hf.gpu, hf.image_px, hf.n_images, hf.hf_mean_ms, aic.aic_ms, hf.hf_mean_ms / NULLIF(aic.aic_ms, 0) AS ratio FROM hf JOIN aic USING (gpu, image_px, n_images)) SELECT gpu, image_px, COUNT(*) AS denominator_pairs, MIN(n_images) AS min_n_images, MAX(n_images) AS max_n_images, MIN(ratio) AS min_ratio, MAX(ratio) AS max_ratio, AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ratio < 1.4 OR ratio > 1.6) AS exact_outside_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ROUND(ratio::numeric, 1) < 1.4 OR ROUND(ratio::numeric, 1) > 1.6) AS rounded_1dp_outside_count, JSONB_AGG(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('n_images', n_images, 'hf_mean_ms', hf_mean_ms, 'aic_ms', aic_ms, 'ratio', ratio) ORDER BY n_images) AS per_n_breakdown FROM pairs GROUP BY gpu, image_px
raw.observed: 8 matched RTX 5090/448px pairs over N=1–128: ratio 1.3599220887631593–1.615916856582029 (mean 1.4654744772166317); 0 pairs fall outside 1.4–1.6 after one-decimal rounding.
raw.evidence: The owning measurement relation pairs measured_5x50 HuggingFace means with aic_postinfill denominators at identical GPU, resolution, and N; the exact endpoints round to the claimed one-decimal range.
